This is hymn number 80 titled "God of Nations, Near and Far" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Tracy Y. Cannon and the lyrics were written by John Taylor.
